island.name: Path D river-terrace horseshoe -- Daguerreo massif ensemble (world 9013, sentinel disc 9)

donor_blocks.note: Donor.txt in every block; the carry shifted z by +320 (5 block rows)

island.shape: a horseshoe, not a ring: one narrow lowland grass ribbon (topo 0, y 2.22-4.79, half-width 1-10u) wrapping the west, south and east flanks of a central massif; the massif is a topo-49 cliff band rising to a topo-13 terrace bowl at y 15.36-17.49 with a y=31.44 peak; a topo-37 forest patch rides the north limb; the coast is all topo-58 wall, no beach parts

comp0_lowland_horseshoe.note: THE walkable island -- landing and trigger both live here

comp1_terrace_bowl.note: SEALED: 4.12u of topo-49 cliff with a 12.38u rise separates it from comp0

comp2_east_lobe.note: detached: 27.66u of blocked ground from comp0 -- unreachable on foot

comp3_topo20_patch.note: the river/shallow topograph, far SE corner, also detached

landing.face_note: face 238 = (dx,dz)=(-sin(f/256*2pi),-cos(f/256*2pi))=(0.428,-0.904) -- the exact bearing from the landing to the massif centroid within 130u (378.4,-705.6). The cone score is flat across 236-246 (best 242 = 3126 of 3126 massif samples, chosen 238 = 3120, a 0.2% difference), so the centroid bearing is used, as in the batch-1 precedent.
landing.relief_note: dead flat at +-1u (0.000); a 0.582u sag over the whole 11u box -- a ~5% grade, no step
landing.sees: Standing on the wide south-west lawn at the horseshoe's open end, dead flat at y=2.39, one walkable sheet, 8u of clean grass in every direction. Facing 238 the camera looks north-north-east straight into the massif: the topo-49 cliff wall starts 12u ahead and fills 32.7% of the +-35deg / 130u cone, and the terrace bowl rides above it -- ALL 821 topo-13 bowl samples on the island are inside this one cone, the crest 17u out at 40.5deg of elevation, so the terraces read as a stacked skyline rather than a distant hill. Grass fills another 20.6% (the ribbon running away east and west), the far north-limb forest 4.8%, and sea only 30.3% -- the frame is land and rock, not water. The exit trigger sits at the far end of the east limb, out of sight behind the massif's south shoulder, which is what makes the walk a tour.

trigger.recommendation: OPTION (b) LOWLAND -- option (a) NATIVE is dead, see native_option_verdict

retarget.note: largest all-comp0 disc that keeps its ARMED TRIANGLE FOOTPRINT strictly inside the 32u cell. (427,-722) r=9 also measures all-clean but its footprint touches x=416.00, the cell-13 boundary exactly; (428,-721) r=9 keeps 2.74u of margin on the tight side and loses only 3 triangles.

openness_notes: POOR SPOT: the entrance cell is 24% BLOCKED terrain (topo not on-foot-walkable -- river/cliff); the player may get trapped. Prefer an open, all-walkable cell.
trigger.openness_verdict: FIRES at 23.8% blocked -- and this is the LOWEST reading of any cell on the island (the others run 33-85%). The note's window is the whole 32u cell, which here reaches past the lawn onto the massif's cliff toe and the coast wall; the retarget disc itself is 18u across and 100% topo-0 grass, and the corridor is walkable through it in both directions (47 ticks north, 42 ticks south-east). Judge the disc, not the box.

native_option_verdict.verdict: DEAD -- three independent ways, any one of which kills it
native_option_verdict.1_not_deployed: the cave-mouth tile is not in the live world at all. Its 8 triangles (idall 0x70D2 = event 1, area 48, topo 52, flags 2) live in the donor's OBJECT mesh, stock disc-1 Block[5][16] object, not in Terrain. The horseshoe carry deployed Terrain + Sea3/4/5 only -- there is no Object.ff9mesh and no Beach1.ff9mesh in any of the six blocks. Census of every deployed file AND every .prerim backup: 0 event-armed triangles.
native_option_verdict.2_mesh_void: the footprint is a HOLE. A sky cast at all 8 target-frame centroids (x 380.42-383.09, z -704.40..-705.98) returns NO HIT -- no mesh of any kind. The void spans x[371,390] z[-712,-699], 153 1u samples across cells (11,21),(11,22),(12,21),(12,22), ringed by topo-49 cliff / topo-13 bowl / topo-58 wall. The donor's object mesh WAS that floor.
native_option_verdict.3_unreachable: even fully restored the tile sits at y=16.41, inside the terrace-bowl shelf, which is a separate 8-connected component. walk_sim stalls on every approach bearing tried.
native_option_verdict.cost_if_pursued: deploy Block[5][11] Object.ff9mesh (47 tris) + Block[5][10] (20) + Block[6][11] (8) to restore the pad, THEN carve a walkable ramp through the topo-49 band -- new authored surface on both the mesh and the terrain, for a trigger the player still cannot reach until the ramp is playtested.

route.trail_note: 246 ticks along the horseshoe's south arc: east across the south-west lawn, north up the middle strand at x 376-396, east along the z=-690 band, then north up the east limb into the disc. Max |dy| per tick 0.090u -- no drop anywhere. ZERO ticks on the topo-37 forest: the route stays 13u+ south of it the whole way.
route.topo49_blips_note: the crossing log shows 1-2 tick topo-49 blips (e.g. tick 29 at (363.8,-660.0)). These are artifacts of sampling the 1u map at round(x),round(z) where the lawn abuts the cliff toe -- the walker itself never stands on a blocked triangle or it would stall, and it does not.

tour_value.evidence: comp1 (the topo-13 bowl, 821 samples, y 15.36-17.49) is a separate 8-connected component. Its closest approach to comp0 is 4.12u at (396,-691)->(395,-695) with a 12.38u rise, and a 40-step transect across that gap is topo-49 (not on-foot walkable) for 37 of 41 samples, climbing y 3.46 -> 15.69 monotonically. walk_sim was driven at the bowl from 10 start points on 8 bearings: 6 starts are not even walkable ground, and all 4 that are stall within 42 ticks. There is no ramp.
tour_value.bridge: no bridge is visible either -- the donor's Object meshes (Block[5][15] 20 tris y 16.41-29.40, Block[5][16] 47 tris, Block[6][16] 8 tris) were never deployed, so the island ships zero object geometry.
tour_value.east_lobe: comp2 (785 samples, x 457-492 / z -763..-728) is likewise unreachable -- 27.66u of blocked ground from comp0. From the lowland it reads as a separate islet across a channel.
tour_value.what_the_tour_IS: the 246-tick arc around the massif's south and east flanks: the player walks the full horseshoe with the cliff wall and the terraces on their left the whole way, the sea on their right, and never leaves grass. That is the island's tour.
tour_value.forest_crossing: no route in this spec touches the forest. For the record, the one pairing that did (east-limb landing -> cell (11,23) trigger) spent 70 of 171 ticks on topo-37 and hit a 1.96u per-tick drop -- rejected.
